record.question: An ideal transformer is one which has
options: a common core for its primary and secondary windings
core of stainless steel and windings of pure copper wire
record.explanation: An ideal transformer has zero copper losses, zero core losses, and zero magnetic flux leakage between primary and secondary windings.
